description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class which encapsulates configuration options for JWT token issuing, including claims and signing credentials, for use within an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates options and claims configurations used for issuing JWT tokens, including issuer, subject, audience, token lifetime, and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property returning a function that generates a unique JWT ID (jti) using GUIDs.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A property that computes the expiration DateTime for the token based on the IssuedAt time and ValidFor duration.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC time when the token is issued.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC time, indicating the earliest time the token is valid.
